frozen_by: Owner decision 2026-09-15: freeze K=3 from the pre-registered study; no second pooled 2015-2026 threshold search; holdout does not retune K.

rule.definition: m = min(home_n_current, away_n_current): each team's final, box-complete, current-season (season type 2 or 3) games visible under the frozen as-of rule (started before the prediction instant and on an earlier ET calendar date).
rule.consistency: Equals artifact.json params.min_current_games = 3 and feature_spec.json eligibility.min_current_games = 3 (fixed before holdout). The runtime refuses to start if they ever differ.

metadata_flags.effect: Factual, non-model metadata only. It does not change the probability, the pick, the confidence tier, eligibility or grading.
metadata_flags.evidence: The 2025-26 holdout 3-5 slice was weak (n=45, log loss 0.7132, Brier 0.25896, accuracy 0.4889, AUC 0.5751); validation 2015-2024 was not (n=185, log loss 0.626).

derivation.preregistration_commit: fa97b6a (2026-09-15T15:48:39-05:00), before any bin metric was computed
derivation.decision_rule: K = smallest integer in 0..13 satisfying on VALIDATION seasons 2015-2024 only: (a) every bin of m >= K beats the home-win-rate baseline log loss (bins n < 60 merged); (b) cumulative m >= K calibration slope in [0.80, 1.25] and ECE <= 0.050; (c) entry slice K..K+2 log loss < 0.660. Contract threshold = max(K, 3).

mechanical_selection.K1: fail: (a) bin 1-2 log loss 0.714 vs home rate 0.697; (c) 0.684
mechanical_selection.K2: fail: (a) bin 2-2 log loss 0.720 vs home rate 0.704; (c) 0.663
mechanical_selection.K3: pass: (a) all bins beat home rate; (b) slope 1.045, ECE 0.032; (c) 3-5 log loss 0.626

holdout_caveats.judged_the_same_way_for_K3: FAIL on (c) only: entry slice extended to m 3-7 for n >= 60 (n=71) has log loss 0.685 above the 0.660 floor. (a) passes on merged bins (3-8: 0.640 vs 0.685; 9+: 0.606 vs 0.685); (b) passes (slope 0.876, ECE 0.039).
holdout_caveats.interpretation: Early-season weakness is real in 2025-26 and absent across ten validation seasons. By the pre-registered rule the holdout does not move K. It is disclosed here and surfaced to readers through LIMITED_TEAM_HISTORY, not by altering any model output.
holdout_caveats.not_done: No second (pooled 2015-2026) threshold search, by owner decision.
